about: The secreta of the formulary “Exaltation of the Holy Cross” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We who are about to take as nourishment the Body and Blood of Jesus Christ our Lord, through Whom the Cross became a holy emblem, beseech You, O Lord our God, that, as we have been found worthy to adore it, so we may forever enjoy the saving effect of its glory. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
